# Episode 516: Gene Therapy in the Retina Space with Dr. David Kirn


Dr. David Kirn, co-founder and CEO of 4D Molecular Therapeutics, joins us to discuss gene therapy in the retina space.


Disclosures: This episode was sponsored by Cited. Cited is PubMed meets Instagram Stories for retina specialists, free to download, made for hearing what your peers think about the latest research.
